lines: I was messing with the trail photo of Evan. I opened something. A void.
You wake in the driver's seat. Same road. Wrong color. The phone is dead. Mom's house is ahead, and every window is dark. You put the car in the garage. It does not turn over.
Mom is in the passenger seat. She does not ask what you saw. The camera is face-down on the dash.
Mom is in the passenger seat. She does not look up.
Evan, on the trail. Something behind him is wrong.
I am in the car. Do not answer.

itemDesc.stick: Taped from tonight's game. Quiet, until the tape gives.
itemDesc.knife: From the kitchen block. The edge is already nicked.
itemDesc.pistol: One shot is loud enough for the whole house. There is no street left to hear it.
itemDesc.ammo: A few rounds. Spend one only if you mean it.
itemDesc.bandage: Enough to stop the shaking and keep walking.
itemDesc.pills: The date on the bottle is still good. The rest of the house is not.
itemDesc.film: One exposure. The garage bench can hold this room. There are not many slides.
itemDesc.tape: Wrap the hockey stick before the shaft splits.
itemDesc.key-her: From the left side of the bathroom cabinet. It opens her door, off the hall.
itemDesc.key-base: Still warm from the sweater pocket. The basement door is in the mudroom.
itemDesc.key-shed: A ring with the name scratched off. It opens the shed in the yard.
itemDesc.key-car: Yours. She had them again. They go in the ignition.
itemDesc.fuse: The yard door will not lift without it. It goes in the car.
itemDesc.gas: Heavy. The gauge was on empty. Pour it into the car.
itemDesc.camera: The bulbs stun whatever is wearing the smile. The plate in the back is for a photo of the car, not the face.
